hooks.command: p=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) || exit 0; "$p" -X utf8 -c 'import sys,json,re; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=d.get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path","").replace("\\","/"); (print(f"[hook] BLOCKED: {f} is a Colab-produced artifact — regenerate via notebook, do not hand-edit", file=sys.stderr) or sys.exit(2)) if re.search(r"_completed\.ipynb$|/experiments/|/checkpoints/|/offline_data/(?!.*\.md$)", f) else None'

p=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) || exit 0; "$p" -X utf8 -c 'import sys,json,re,subprocess,os,shutil; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=d.get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path","").replace("\\","/"); m=re.search(r"/scripts/(run_|summarize_)[^/]*\.sh$", f); b=shutil.which("bash"); sys.exit(0) if not m or not os.path.exists(f) or not b else (lambda r: (print(f"[hook] bash -n failed on {f}:\n{r.stderr}", file=sys.stderr) or sys.exit(2)) if r.returncode!=0 else sys.exit(0))(subprocess.run([b,"-n",f], capture_output=True, text=True))'
s="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/hooks/doc_pointers.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; p=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) || exit 0; "$p" -X utf8 "$s"
